name: BLOOD BOWL: MINOTAUR
description:
Minotaurs come from a desolate area known only as the Dark Lands. The parched earth is cracked, and volcanic activity belches choking smoke into the air. This terrible place happens to be a great recruiting ground for hardy Blood Bowl players! Minotaurs are hulking walls of muscle, with a long stride, horns, and even the occasional claw or tentacle. They love nothing more than pounding their rivals to pulp on the pitch.

Give 'em the Horns

This multipart plastic kit builds a Minotaur, a Big Guy for your Chaos Chosen, Chaos Renegades, and Chaos Dwarfs teams in games of Blood Bowl. If you're looking for speed and hitting power, you can't go wrong with a Minotaur on your line of scrimmage.

This miniature includes some options for customisation. You can build it to match Chaos Dwarf aesthetics or with a more universal Chaos look, with 2 different horns, 2 shoulder pads, and 2 belt decoration options. You'll find 2 different tails, as well as open hands, claws for both left and right hands, a tentacle for the left hand, and a knuckle-duster for the right hand.

Contents:
– 25 plastic components
– 1 Citadel 40mm Round Base
– 1 construction guide

This miniature requires assembly and is supplied unpainted. We recommend:
– Citadel Tools: Super Fine Detail Cutters
– Warhammer Colour Plastic Glue
– Warhammer Colour paints
